sentences.text: The greenhouse effect occurs when heat-trapping gases in a planet's atmosphere prevent the planet from losing heat to space, raising its surface temperature.

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“The greenhouse effect”，再看句法中心“occurs”。从句或非谓语补充部分候选为“when heat-trapping gases in a planet's atmosphere prevent the planet from losing heat to space, raising its surface temperature”；先读主句，再核对各部分与中心词的关系。

sentences.text: Surface heating can happen from an internal heat source (as in the case of Jupiter) or come from an external source, such as a host star.

sentences.text: In the case of Earth, the Sun emits shortwave radiation (sunlight) that passes through greenhouse gases to heat the Earth's surface.

sentences.readingHintZh: 先找主语候选“the Sun”，再看句法中心“emits”。再读与中心词连接的宾语或补语候选“shortwave radiation (sunlight) that passes through greenhouse gases to heat the Earth's surface”，确认动作对象或说明内容。解析器标出的定语从句候选是“that passes through greenhouse gases to heat the Earth's surface”；先读被修饰的名词，再回看这部分补充说明。从句或非谓语补充部分候选为“to heat the Earth's surface”；先读主句，再核对各部分与中心词的关系。

sentences.text: In response, the Earth's surface emits longwave radiation that is mostly absorbed by greenhouse gases, reducing the rate at which the Earth can cool off.

objectsOrComplements.text: longwave radiation that is mostly absorbed by greenhouse gases, reducing the rate at which the Earth can cool off

at which the Earth can cool off

subordinateClauses.text: reducing the rate at which the Earth can cool off

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 the Earth's surface emits longwave radiation。that is mostly absorbed by greenhouse gases 修饰 radiation；逗号后的 reducing ... 说明前述过程的结果。at which the Earth can cool off 修饰 rate，其中 at which 对应 at that rate。

sentences.text: Without the greenhouse effect, the Earth's average surface temperature would be as cold as −18 °C (−0.4 °F).

sentences.text: The Sun has a surface temperature of 5,500 °C (9,900 °F), so it emits most of its energy as shortwave radiation in near-infrared and visible wavelengths (as sunlight).

sentences.readingHintZh: so 连接因果相关的两个分句：The Sun has a surface temperature ... 与 it emits ...。前一分句说明原因，后一分句说明结果；不要把 The Sun has ... 标成非谓语短语。in near-infrared and visible wavelengths 说明辐射所在波段。

sentences.text: In contrast, Earth's surface has a much lower temperature, so it emits longwave radiation at mid- and far-infrared wavelengths.

sentences.readingHintZh: In contrast 承接前句的太阳，转而比较地球。Earth's surface has a much lower temperature 是前一分句，so it emits ... 是结果分句；两处主语指同一对象。mid- and far-infrared 为并列的波段描述。
